attendance.question: How do I register for NEARCON 2026?
attendance.answer: You can register for the event directly through our Luma page accessible from nearcon.org.

attendance.question: What does my registration include?
attendance.answer: Registration includes access to all conference sessions and events.

attendance.question: How will I know that I am registered?
attendance.answer: You will receive a confirmation when registered.

attendance.question: How do I pick up my badge at the event?
attendance.answer: Badge pickup information will be provided closer to the event date.

general.question: When and where is NEARCON 2026?
general.answer: NEARCON takes place February 23-24, 2026 at Fort Mason Center for Arts & Culture, San Francisco, California, USA.

general.question: Is there a dress code?
general.answer: No formal dress code is required. NEARCON is a conference and cultural gathering — wear what makes you comfortable.

general.question: Do I need a travel visa to attend NEARCON?
general.answer: International attendees are responsible for securing any required travel visas. Please check your country's requirements.

general.question: Will there be WiFi at the event?
general.answer: Yes. Complimentary WiFi will be available to all registered attendees at Fort Mason Center.

participation.question: What is the privacy policy for NEARCON 2026?
participation.answer: Your basic registration information (name, company, email) may be encoded in your badge. By allowing a sponsor to scan your badge, you consent to sharing this information with them.

participation.question: What accessibility measures are in place?
participation.answer: Fort Mason Center is ADA compliant. We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive experience for all attendees.

participation.question: Are photography and video allowed?
participation.answer: Personal photography is welcome in public areas. Professional video and livestreaming require written approval from the NEARCON Media Team.

participation.question: What is the photo/video release policy?
participation.answer: By registering for NEARCON, you agree that photographs and video taken at the event may be used by NEAR Foundation.

press.question: How can I obtain a press pass?
press.answer: Apply for press credentials through the press form on nearcon.org. All applications are reviewed and approved by the NEARCON Media Team.

safety.question: What is the bag policy?
safety.answer: All bags are subject to security screening upon entry to Fort Mason Center and other official venues. Please allow extra time for security screening.

safety.question: What safety measures are in place?
safety.answer: Safety is a top priority at NEARCON. Venue security and staff will be present at all times. All attendees must have a valid badge to access event areas.
